metrics.name: memory.rss
metrics.brief: Process-wide Resident Set Size — physical RAM currently used by the process. Matches what external tools report (e.g. `kubectl top pod`, `htop`, `ps rss`).

metrics.name: cpu.utilization
metrics.brief: Process-wide CPU utilization as a ratio in [0, 1], normalized across all logical CPU cores on the system (not just engine-assigned cores). Aligned with the OTel semantic convention `process.cpu.utilization`. The `cpu.mode` attribute is not set; this reports combined user + system time.

metrics.name: memory.pressure.state
metrics.brief: Process-wide memory limiter state encoded as `0=normal`, `1=soft`, `2=hard`.

metrics.name: process.memory.usage.bytes
metrics.brief: Most recent process-wide memory limiter sample, in bytes.

metrics.name: process.memory.soft.limit.bytes
metrics.brief: Effective process-wide memory limiter soft limit, in bytes.

metrics.name: process.memory.hard.limit.bytes
metrics.brief: Effective process-wide memory limiter hard limit, in bytes.
